notes.title: Localization & Tutorial Speed Improvements
notes.content:
🌍 Localization Fixes
Several language issues have been resolved:
• Japanese
• Korean
• Simplified Chinese
• Traditional Chinese

Tutorial Text Update
Tutorial text now appears 50% faster, making the early game flow more smoothly.

Big thanks to everyone who provided feedback and reported these issues!
More updates are on the way.

notes.title: Tutorial Fixes & New Starting Café
notes.content:
A new update is live!

This small patch addresses some key issues while improving the early game experience:

• Fixed UI naming inconsistencies
• Resolved selling bugs with certain furniture items
• Ambient and SFX audio now play correctly
• Audio settings now save and apply properly
• Adjusted coffee prices for better balance
• Updated the default starting café
• Tutorial can no longer be broken or softlocked

Note: Since the default starting café has been changed, we recommend starting a new game to experience the updated setup.

Thanks again for all your support.
Your feedback plays a huge role in making the game better.
